description.message: Turn a section of the YouTube video you are watching into a GIF, without downloading the whole video.

startTitle.message: Clip start: set to the current time

endTitle.message: Clip end: set to the current time

makeTitle.message: Create a GIF of the selected range

heavy.message: This GIF will be large. Click again to create it anyway.

staleScript.message: ClipRange was updated. Reload the page to use it.

endBeforeStart.message: The end must come after the start.

hostMissing.message: The ClipRange host is not installed. Run the ClipRange installer, then reload this page.

hostSilent.message: The native host exited without replying.

backgroundStopped.message: The extension background stopped before replying.

errorToolMissing.message: yt-dlp or ffmpeg is not installed. Open the extension options to install them.

toolsHint.message: Leave a path empty to use the copy downloaded by ClipRange, or one found on your PATH. yt-dlp needs updating regularly to keep up with YouTube.

palettePerFrame.message: One palette per frame (better colors, larger file)

outputHint.message: Larger and faster GIFs get heavy quickly: 480 px at 15 fps is around 1 MB per second of video.
